rollback.sql: DROP COLLATION natural_order; DROP TABLE accounts;

changeSet.author: dogancaglar
changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW ledger_account_directory AS SELECT l.account_code, l.ledger_type AS account_type, CASE WHEN owner.kind = 'SELLER' THEN owner.parent_code ELSE l.parent_code END AS master_account_code, CASE WHEN owner.kind = 'SELLER' THEN owner.account_code END AS sub_entity_id, l.currency, l.status FROM accounts l JOIN accounts owner ON owner.account_code = l.parent_code WHERE l.kind = 'LEDGER';
